description: How far off the route a field is still one the flight may divert to, for keeping its plates (Keep for the Air): the 45 minutes of reserve 14 CFR 91.167(a)(3) asks under IFR and 91.151(a)(2) at night under VFR (kept by day too, more than 91.151(a)(1)'s 30: more plates, never fewer) at the airplane's own cruise, or its whole tanks' reach where that is less. Null with no cruise speed: never a stock airplane's.

tas_kt.description: The airplane's cruise true airspeed, knots (its profile's); null or missing where none is picked.

usable_gal.description: Its usable fuel, gallons; null or missing for none.

burn_gph.description: Its cruise burn, gallons an hour; null or missing for none.

range_nm.description: The range, nm; null with no cruise speed.
